submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires on a short word-opening fragment token (most strongly a lone capital 'G' or 'C', lowercase '-c'/'-g' after a hyphen, or the digit '1' that opens a multi-digit year or number) when the context implies the word or number continues in the following tokens (Gaurav, Gobbles, Civilian, catalyzed, 1850, 1999). It stays near zero on whole-word tokens, on single letters that are complete words (vitamin C), and on numbers that open with other digits (7850).

rival_explanations: Token identity alone: the direction fires on the tokens 'G', 'C' and '1' wherever they occur, so it should also fire on standalone 'C' in 'vitamin C' or 'grade of C' and on the '1' of '1 dollar'.

Broader word-start reading: it fires on the first fragment of any word split over several tokens, whatever the letter, so 'L'/'B'/'T' openings and numbers opening with any digit should fire about as much as 'G', 'C' and '1'.
